stories.title: QB Beau Pribula traveled 6K miles in eight days to find a new home. He wasn't alone
stories.summary: Among the struggles? Finding yourself on a visit and another player takes your roster spot.

stories.title: 5-team deal sends Watson to Cavs, Strus to Clips
stories.summary: The Cavaliers, Nuggets and Clippers have agreed on a trade that will send Peyton Watson to Cleveland and Max Strus to Los Angeles, sources told ESPN. Watson will sign a new four-year, $88 million deal to join the Cavaliers, his agents said.

stories.title: O's bash MLB technology after near-HR ruled foul
stories.summary: The Orioles criticized MLB for being behind on technology after Pete Alonso's deep fly to left was ruled foul and the call was upheld on a review Wednesday night against the Yankees.

stories.title: US Open singles champs to earn record $5.5M
stories.summary: Singles champions will earn a record $5.5 million at this year's US Open, with overall player compensation increasing 20% from last year's tournament.

stories.title: Verstappen: 'Closer to retiring' than joining a rival
stories.summary: After signing a new deal to remain at Red Bull until the end of 2030, Max Verstappen has said he never felt the desire to switch teams and revealed he was closer to leaving the sport entirely than signing for a rival.
